response.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
), shares AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count,
         qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM project_counts
), deviations AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM deviations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Projects means projects represented by at least one QC record; projects with no QC records are excluded from the shares and average.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every project, including projects with zero QC records, in the average share.
alternatives.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry AS arcref, COUNT(q.qualregistry) AS qc_count
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN scanqc q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry
), shares AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count,
         qc_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(qc_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM project_counts
), deviations AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM deviations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
